parsed.explanation: Elevated-risk. There is no criminalisation, no documented universal facility/custody exclusion, and no visible organised targeting of visitors; decriminalisation and official SOGI-sensitive guidance are modest climate positives. But present evidence shows institutional failure if a trans person is outed: heightened assault concern, one victim’s complaints dismissed by police because of a male marker, family pressure toward acceptance, slow referrals, and healthcare discrimination/poor service. No enforceable anti-discrimination remedy is documented, so recourse is thin. Visitor-specific frequency is not well measured, and the 4x assault multiplier is unverified, but the documented practice outweighs mere friction. Subnational variation is unevidenced; remote conformity pressure is noted only as uncertainty. Overall below reduced-risk anchors with working protections, above universal-exclusion profiles.
